subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Coffee is a natural—and economically important—beverage that is produced from beans grown in tropical regions.
• Brazil is a leading producer of coffee beans.
• The roasting level of coffee beans varies across different preparation methods.
• Arabica beans are roasted to a medium level and are used for espresso drinks.
• Colombian beans are roasted to a medium level and are used for espresso drinks.
• French roast beans are roasted to a dark level and are used for bold breakfast blends.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize how French roast coffee differs from Arabica and Colombian coffee. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: French roast coffee is just one of the many kinds of coffees, each originating from a different roasting method.
choices.B: Coffee roasting varies from method to method, so French roast coffee will be different than other kinds of coffee.
choices.C: Coffee is an economically important beverage—especially in Brazil—that can be used to make espresso drinks or even breakfast blends.
choices.D: The medium-roasted Arabica and Colombian beans are used for espresso drinks, whereas the darker French roast beans are used in bold breakfast blends.

explanation: Choice D is the best answer. This choice most effectively emphasizes how French roast coffee differs from Arabica and Colombian coffee. It describes the difference in roasting level and the difference in what they're used for.
